name: Qatar Airways Privilege Club Credit Card (Infinite)

localized_names.en: Qatar Airways Privilege Club Credit Cards

apr.notes: APR not visible on product page. See Rates & Fees disclosure at legal.cardless.com/schumer/premium-499-qatar/rates_and_fees.pdf (linked but not fetched).

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fee stated on page for both Signature and Infinite cards.

base_rate.description: Earn Avios when you use your Privilege Club Card everywhere else. Page description mentions 'Earn up to 5x Avios' but specific multipliers for the Infinite card not rendered in text.

rewards.redemption_notes: You'll get 2 Qpoints for every 1,500 Avios you earn using your card (Infinite card). Miles do not expire for as long as you use your card.

signup_bonus.description: Earn up to 50,000 Avios: 25,000 Avios after your first transaction + 25,000 Avios after spending a total of $5,000 in the first 90 days. Plus 150 Qpoints.

benefits.title: Miles Do Not Expire
benefits.description: Miles do not expire for as long as you use your card.

benefits.title: Privilege Club Gold Status (First Year)
benefits.description: In your first year, experience Privilege Club Gold with access to benefits: 75% tier bonus on eligible flights, Priority stand-by, Priority check-in & boarding, Preferred seats, 20kg extra baggage allowance, Lounge access, 40 Qcredits to redeem for upgrades/excess baggage, Al Maha 'meet and assist' service, Discount on online redemptions. oneworld tier: Sapphire.

benefits.title: Qpoints Earning
benefits.description: You'll get 2 Qpoints for every 1,500 Avios you earn using your card.

lounge_access.notes: Lounge access (via Privilege Club Gold status, first year)

travel_perks.free_checked_bags: 20kg extra baggage allowance (via Privilege Club Gold status, first year)
other: Privilege Club Gold status first year (oneworld Sapphire): 75% tier bonus, priority stand-by/check-in/boarding, preferred seats, 40 Qcredits, Al Maha meet & assist, discount on online redemptions

notes: Verified from official Qatar Airways Privilege Club Credit Cards page. This entry is for the Infinite card ($499 annual fee). The page also lists a Signature card ($99 annual fee). Signup bonus: 25,000 Avios after first transaction + 25,000 Avios after $5,000 in 90 days = 50,000 total + 150 Qpoints. Specific earn rate multipliers (e.g. 5x, 3x) referenced in page description but not rendered in fetched text for the Infinite card. APR not visible; see Rates & Fees PDF linked on page.
